verses.text: Then Job answered:
"No doubt you are the only wise people, and wisdom will die with you!
But I have a mind just as you do. I am not less than you. Who doesn't know all these things?
I have become a joke to my friends, I who called on God and was answered. I am a good man with no fault, and yet I am a joke.
People who are comfortable look down on those in trouble. They think trouble comes to those whose feet slip.
The tents of robbers are peaceful, and those who make God angry are safe, those who carry their god in their hands.
But ask the animals, and they will teach you. Ask the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.
Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. Let the fish of the sea tell you.
Which of all these does not know that the LORD's hand has done this?
The life of every living thing is in his hand, and the breath of every human being.
Doesn't the ear test words, just as the tongue tastes food?
Wisdom is found among older people, and understanding comes with a long life.
But true wisdom and power belong to God. Advice and understanding are his.
What he tears down cannot be rebuilt. When he puts someone in prison, no one can let him out.
If he holds back the rain, everything dries up. If he lets the waters loose, they flood the earth.
Strength and success belong to him. Both the one who is fooled and the one who fools others are under his control.
He leads advisers away stripped of everything, and he makes judges look like fools.
He takes away the power of kings and ties a rope around their waists.
He leads priests away stripped of everything, and overthrows those who have been in power a long time.
He silences trusted advisers and takes away the good sense of the elders.
He brings shame on rulers and takes away the strength of the powerful.
He shows the deep things hidden in darkness and brings deep shadows into the light.
He makes nations great, and then destroys them. He makes nations large, and then scatters them.
He takes away the understanding of the world's leaders and sends them wandering in a desert where there is no path.
They feel their way in the dark with no light. He makes them stagger like drunks."
